title: Nutty Sweet Canadian Sugar Wrap
description: Buttery, chewy, and sweet, this Canadian dish is a perfect date-night treat, featuring a delicate balance of sugar and marinate, all wrapped up in a keto-friendly corn-husk vessel.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the granulated sugar, brown sugar, and 2 tablespoons of butter. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves and starts to caramelize.
Set the saucepan aside to cool slightly.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut oil, marinade, pecans, maple syrup, cornstarch, salt, and vanilla extract.
Add the whisked mixture to the saucepan with the sugar mixture and stir until well combined.
Stuff each corn husk with the mixture, leaving a small border around the edges.
Fold the bottom edge of the corn husk up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Place the wraps in a baking dish and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the tops are lightly golden brown.
Serve warm, topped with whipped heavy cream if desired.
